scope: Incremental contracts, not a new global population or plan

contracts.behavior: Manifest dependency graph yields valid order or rejects cyclic input
contracts.side_effects: No database writes; ordering fails before yielding invalid graph
contracts.consumers: settings ordered LOCAL_APPS and report consumers
contracts.existing_adaptation: Consumer raises domain error; native Odoo catches recursion and removes cyclic nodes
contracts.limitations: No qualification of arbitrarily deep recursion; missing dependency reporting is distinct

contracts.behavior: Bound objects and migration roster preserve database boundary
contracts.inputs_outputs: company id/object state/alias -> db route or migrate decision
contracts.side_effects: Reads/writes scoped to separate fixture databases; rollback retained
contracts.consumers: IrModule QuerySet and Django migration executor
contracts.existing_adaptation: Django adapter separates base domain apps from control plane
contracts.limitations: Whole company migration fails auth/contenttypes dependency; sessions/contenttypes decision unresolved

contracts.behavior: Enabled candidates honor trigger semantics and installable flag
contracts.inputs_outputs: installed-name set plus auto flag/list -> candidates
contracts.side_effects: Candidate computation only; no persistent module-state transition
contracts.existing_adaptation: Empty list/tuple enables automatic candidate; False disables
contracts.limitations: No per-database installation, hooks or loader acceptance

contracts.behavior: Installed modules determine effective model composition per database
contracts.execution_flow: Current Consumer copies global Django model classes into alias registry
contracts.inputs_outputs: Distinct per-db module state -> observed identical class universe
contracts.side_effects: Different registry dictionaries still share class identities
contracts.dependencies: Django Apps/ModelBase; per-db state; module composition and cache invalidation
contracts.consumers: All ORM model access and addon extensions
contracts.limitations: Two DB connections do not establish model isolation; naming search does not prove absence of indirect dispatch

contracts.behavior: Schema evolution and removal must preserve lifecycle and ownership contracts
contracts.execution_flow: Native MigrationExecutor forward -> reverse; existing metadata cleanup primitives
contracts.inputs_outputs: contenttypes migration targets -> schema/history; company auth migration -> failure
contracts.side_effects: Schema creation/column removal/reversal rollback tested on own DB
contracts.dependencies: PostgreSQL; contenttypes/auth FK; metadata ownership; hook dispatch
contracts.consumers: Django migration engine; future module lifecycle consumer
contracts.existing_adaptation: Native schema primitives exist; addon orchestration not qualified
contracts.limitations: Primitive PASS does not prove addon install/upgrade/uninstall; company migration FAIL retained
contracts.integration: TASK-API-0382/0383; historical GEN0298 completed not proof of integrated transitions

contracts.behavior: Context and cache/registry changes must respect concurrency and process boundaries
contracts.execution_flow: ContextVar interleave; concurrent two-DB reads; isolated fork memory experiment
contracts.inputs_outputs: company scopes -> isolated values; child mutation -> unchanged parent
contracts.side_effects: Transactions rolled back; child process joined; no global registry mutation
contracts.dependencies: Gunicorn worker lifecycle; explicit signaling contract
contracts.existing_adaptation: Thread SQL and async context separately tested; no async SQL assertion
contracts.limitations: No real multiworker registry refresh/reload qualification; isolated fork is narrower
contracts.integration: No Provider model inference; further bounded verifier required
